scope: Shared native Markdown line-fragment padding and Chat/Work/Remote regression

observations.conclusion: MarkdownTextRenderer initializes NSTextContainer.lineFragmentPadding with double zero.
Chat assistant body contains OAIMarkdown.MarkdownBlockStack. Remote cached Markdown reaches the same native Markdown subsystem through separately traced callers.

MarkdownTextBlockView.markdownOptions is identified by ivar-offset storage0xb8b7e40. Its inset accessor sums two four-double groups at configuration offsets0x298 and0x2d8, swapping horizontal components according to direction. Intrinsic helper adds these results to renderer size. Actual effective style values remain unresolved.

MarkdownOptions descriptor0x96fca7c is a struct with a single _storage reference resolving to0x96fcaa0. Storage field-vector parsing is unsupported by the existing strict parser, so inset names and effective values remain unknown.

implementation.change: Explicitly set textContainer.lineFragmentPadding=0 for the shared independent UIKit content adapter. This also affects its text/code/reasoning representations.
implementation.attribution: Official renderer configuration reused in independent UITextView host. Native host is not the recovered custom TextKit2 view.
implementation.test_isolation: Chat/Work core test now uses one UUID profile retained for its relaunch assertions.

limitations: Block insets, paragraph styles, outer row spacing, minimum height and footer sizing remain independent or unresolved.
Line fragment configuration alone does not establish full-page visual equivalence.
No physical-device acceptance or Android parity in this batch.

validation.visual: Inspected Chat/light/dark and Remote/light/dark captures. Text and code visible; existing wide vertical gaps and independent footer styling persist. English Chat fixture content remains Chinese.
validation.runtime: v576 signed, installed, executable hash matched; stable Chinese/light preview restored
validation.retention: dry run has no stale package targets

next_actions: Resolve effective ordinary Markdown block style insets and connect to parent before changing vertical spacing.
Close row action visibility and full-page minimal flow ledger.
investigation_limits: Initial class parser correctly rejected MarkdownOptions as a non-class; struct parser resolved it. _Storage class parser rejected unsupported field descriptor. No inferred field labels or tool modifications were used.
